NVDA.name: NVIDIA Corporation
NVDA.description: NVIDIA Corporation is the worldwide pioneer and market leader in accelerated computing and visual computing technologies. Best known for inventing the GPU (Graphics Processing Unit), NVIDIA has transformed from a 3D graphics specialist into the preeminent full-stack computing infrastructure company powering the global Generative AI revolution, hyperscale cloud data centers, autonomous vehicles, and industrial robotics.

AAPL.name: Apple Inc.
AAPL.description: Apple Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables, and accessories, and sells a variety of related high-margin digital services. Anchored by the iPhone, Mac, iPad, and Apple Watch, Apple's proprietary iOS ecosystem commands over 1.4 billion active paid subscriptions and unmatched consumer brand loyalty worldwide.

MSFT.name: Microsoft Corporation
MSFT.description: Microsoft Corporation develops and supports a wide range of software products, cloud platforms, devices, and enterprise technology services. Its flagship Microsoft Cloud (Azure), Microsoft 365 productivity suite, Windows ecosystem, LinkedIn business network, and multi-billion-dollar partnership with OpenAI position it at the foundational layer of modern corporate computing.

TSLA.name: Tesla, Inc.
TSLA.description: Tesla, Inc. designs, develops, manufactures, sells, and leases high-performance fully electric vehicles, energy generation and storage systems, and solar installations. Beyond automotive manufacturing, Tesla is increasingly valued as an AI and robotics conglomerate through its Full Self-Driving (FSD) autonomous software network, Dojo supercomputing cluster, and Optimus humanoid robot platform.

GOOGL.name: Alphabet Inc.
GOOGL.description: Alphabet Inc. is a multinational holding company created through a corporate restructuring of Google. It operates dominant platforms including Google Search, YouTube, Android, Chrome, and Google Cloud, while funding pioneering technological endeavors through its Other Bets division (Waymo autonomous vehicles and Verily life sciences).

AMZN.name: Amazon.com, Inc.
AMZN.description: Amazon.com, Inc. is a global technology conglomerate focusing on e-commerce, cloud computing (Amazon Web Services), digital advertising, and digital streaming. AWS remains the undisputed world leader in public cloud infrastructure, serving as the high-margin profit engine funding logistics and AI innovation across the enterprise.

META.name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
META.description: Meta Platforms, Inc. builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. Its Family of Apps—including Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and Threads—engages over 3.2 billion daily active users, underpinned by world-class open-source AI models (Llama series) and next-generation compute clusters.

PLTR.name: Palantir Technologies Inc.
PLTR.description: Palantir Technologies Inc. builds and deploys foundational software platforms for defense, intelligence, and commercial enterprises. Its flagship products—Gotham, Foundry, and the Artificial Intelligence Platform (AIP)—enable institutions to integrate operational data with generative AI reasoning engines for mission-critical decision making.

AMD.name: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.
AMD.description: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. is a global semiconductor manufacturer producing x86 microprocessors, graphics processing units, server processors (EPYC), and AI accelerators (Instinct MI300 series). AMD delivers high-performance compute architectures for cloud datacenters, enterprise servers, gaming consoles, and personal computers.

JPM.name: JPMorgan Chase & Co.
JPM.description: JPMorgan Chase & Co. is the largest financial institution in the United States and one of the premier global investment banks, with over $4 trillion in assets under management. It operates across Consumer & Community Banking, Corporate & Investment Banking, Commercial Banking, and Asset & Wealth Management.

MMM.name: 3M Company
MMM.description: 3M Company is an American multinational conglomerate operating across industrial adhesives, safety products, filtration materials, commercial branding, and iconic consumer goods (Post-it, Scotch, Command). Founded in 1902 in Two Harbors, Minnesota, 3M holds thousands of active patents driving scalable manufacturing solutions worldwide.

DIS.name: The Walt Disney Company
DIS.description: The Walt Disney Company is a premier global entertainment and media conglomerate operating through Entertainment, Sports (ESPN), and Experiences (theme parks, resorts, and cruise line). With unmatched intellectual property including Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars, and 20th Century Studios, Disney drives direct-to-consumer streaming alongside beloved experiential destinations.

WMT.name: Walmart Inc.
WMT.description: Walmart Inc. is the world's largest company by revenue, operating a global network of over 10,500 stores, hypermarkets, and clubs alongside rapidly growing e-commerce and advertising platforms. Walmart serves approximately 255 million customers weekly, delivering unmatched value and automated supply chain efficiency.

COST.name: Costco Wholesale Corporation
COST.description: Costco Wholesale Corporation operates an international chain of membership warehouses dedicated to offering members low prices on a limited selection of branded and private-label products (Kirkland Signature). Its membership renewal rates exceed 92%, providing stable subscription cash flows and exceptional inventory velocity.

LLY.name: Eli Lilly and Company
LLY.description: Eli Lilly and Company is a global pharmaceutical leader discovering, developing, and marketing breakthrough medicines across diabetes, obesity, oncology, immunology, and neuroscience. Its blockbuster incretin medicines (Mounjaro for type 2 diabetes and Zepbound for obesity) represent some of the fastest-growing pharmaceutical franchises in healthcare history.

AVGO.name: Broadcom Inc.
AVGO.description: Broadcom Inc. is a global technology leader that designs, develops, and supplies a broad range of semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions. Broadcom's category-leading product portfolio serves critical enterprise markets including cloud networking (Tomahawk, Jericho), custom AI ASICs (XPU accelerators), broadband, and VMware enterprise cloud virtualization.

NFLX.name: Netflix, Inc.
NFLX.description: Netflix, Inc. is the world's leading entertainment streaming service with over 277 million paid memberships in more than 190 countries enjoying TV series, films, documentaries, and mobile games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Its content delivery network and proprietary recommendation algorithms drive engagement and industry-leading free cash flow conversion.

CRM.name: Salesforce, Inc.
CRM.description: Salesforce, Inc. is the global leader in Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software, empowering companies of every size and industry to connect with their customers through Einstein 1 Platform, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud, and Slack. Its Agentforce autonomous enterprise agents represent the forefront of generative enterprise workflows.

ADBE.name: Adobe Inc.
ADBE.description: Adobe Inc. is the global authority in digital media and digital marketing software. Its flagship creative platforms (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, InDesign), document cloud (Acrobat, Adobe Sign), and commercially safe generative AI engine (Adobe Firefly) empower millions of creative professionals and enterprise marketing teams worldwide.

INTC.name: Intel Corporation
INTC.description: Intel Corporation is an American multinational corporation and technology company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. Intel designs and manufactures microprocessors for personal computers and data centers, while aggressively investing in Intel Foundry Services (IFS) to establish a premier US-based commercial semiconductor foundry.

QCOM.name: QUALCOMM Incorporated
QCOM.description: QUALCOMM Incorporated develops and commercializes foundational wireless technologies and semiconductor chipsets (Snapdragon) powering smartphones, connected vehicles, personal computing (Snapdragon X Elite), and IoT devices. Qualcomm collects royalty revenues from cellular standards and pioneers edge AI computing architectures.

UBER.name: Uber Technologies, Inc.
UBER.description: Uber Technologies, Inc. is a global technology platform that connects consumers with independent rideshare drivers, food and grocery delivery merchants (Uber Eats), and freight shippers (Uber Freight). Operating across roughly 70 countries, Uber generates significant free cash flow through marketplace network effects.

COIN.name: Coinbase Global, Inc.
COIN.description: Coinbase Global, Inc. operates the leading regulated digital asset exchange and financial technology infrastructure platform in the United States. Coinbase provides custody services for institutional Bitcoin/Ethereum ETFs, consumer trading tools, the Base Ethereum layer-2 scaling network, and stablecoin interest revenue.

BA.name: The Boeing Company
BA.description: The Boeing Company is an American multinational corporation that designs, manufactures, and sells commercial airplanes (737 MAX, 777X, 787 Dreamliner), rotorcraft, rockets, satellites, telecommunications equipment, and defense missiles worldwide. Boeing is one of the world's largest defense contractors and a critical component of global aviation.

CAT.name: Caterpillar Inc.
CAT.description: Caterpillar Inc. is the world's leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines, and diesel-electric locomotives. Operating through Construction Industries, Resource Industries, and Energy & Transportation, Caterpillar commands premier pricing power and dealer networks.

XOM.name: Exxon Mobil Corporation
XOM.description: Exxon Mobil Corporation is the largest energy and petrochemical conglomerate in the Western hemisphere, operating upstream exploration (Guyana, Permian Basin), downstream refining, and specialty chemical manufacturing. ExxonMobil maintains massive free cash flows, industry-leading capital discipline, and robust shareholder dividends.

JNJ.name: Johnson & Johnson
JNJ.description: Johnson & Johnson is an American multinational pharmaceutical and medical technologies corporation. Focusing exclusively on Innovative Medicine (oncology, immunology, neuroscience) and MedTech (cardiovascular, orthopedics, surgery) following its Kenvue spin-off, JNJ commands one of the only AAA credit ratings in global corporate finance.

NKE.name: NIKE, Inc.
NKE.description: NIKE, Inc. is the world's largest athletic footwear, apparel, and equipment company. Driven by iconic sub-brands (Nike, Jordan, Converse), relentless athlete endorsements, and pioneering cushioning technologies (Air, ZoomX), Nike commands unmatched cultural influence and distribution across global athletics.

SBUX.name: Starbucks Corporation
SBUX.description: Starbucks Corporation is the world's premier specialty coffee roaster and retailer, operating over 39,000 stores across 86 global markets. Its industry-leading Starbucks Rewards loyalty program and mobile order ecosystem drive recurring foot traffic and unmatched brand recognition.

MCD.name: McDonald's Corporation
MCD.description: McDonald's Corporation is the world's largest fast-food restaurant company, operating over 41,000 locations across more than 100 countries. By franchising approximately 95% of its restaurants, McDonald's functions primarily as a premier real estate and intellectual property licensing engine generating high-margin cash flows.

KO.name: The Coca-Cola Company
KO.description: The Coca-Cola Company is the world's largest nonalcoholic beverage company, marketing more than 200 brands in over 200 countries (Coca-Cola, Sprite, Fanta, Dasani, Minute Maid, Costa Coffee). Its asset-light concentrate manufacturing model and global bottling network drive substantial operating margins and 62 consecutive years of dividend increases.

V.name: Visa Inc.
V.description: Visa Inc. is a world leader in digital payments, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions, and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories. Its advanced processing network (VisaNet) handles upwards of 280 billion transactions annually with unmatched security and scalability.

MA.name: Mastercard Incorporated
MA.description: Mastercard Incorporated is a global technology company in the payments industry that connects consumers, financial institutions, merchants, governments, and businesses in more than 210 countries. Mastercard operates one of the fastest payment processing networks in the world, generating high operating margins and double-digit cross-border volume growth.

BRK.B.name: Berkshire Hathaway Inc.
BRK.B.description: Berkshire Hathaway Inc. is a multinational conglomerate holding company led by Warren Buffett. It engages in diverse business activities including property and casualty insurance (GEICO, Berkshire Hathaway Reinsurance), freight rail transportation (BNSF Railway), regulated utility and energy generation (BHE), manufacturing, and a massive equity portfolio.

PYPL.name: PayPal Holdings, Inc.
PYPL.description: PayPal Holdings, Inc. is a leading digital commerce technology platform enabling digital payments on behalf of consumers and merchants worldwide (PayPal, Venmo, Braintree, Paidy). With over 425 million active accounts, PayPal processes upwards of .5 trillion in total payment volume annually.

BAC.name: Bank of America Corporation
BAC.description: Bank of America Corporation is one of the world's leading financial institutions, serving individual consumers, small and middle-market businesses, and large corporations with a full range of banking, investing, asset management, and risk management products. Its Merrill wealth management arm oversees over .4 trillion in client balances.

GS.name: The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc.
GS.description: The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. is a leading global investment banking, securities, and investment management firm that provides a wide range of financial services to a substantial and diversified client base including corporations, financial institutions, governments, and individuals.

MS.name: Morgan Stanley
MS.description: Morgan Stanley is a global financial services firm that advises, originates, trades, manages, and distributes capital for governments, institutions, and individuals through Institutional Securities, Wealth Management (E*TRADE), and Investment Management (Eaton Vance). It manages upwards of  trillion in total client assets.

BTC.name: Bitcoin Network
BTC.description: Bitcoin is the world's first decentralized digital currency and global store of value, secured by proof-of-work cryptographic verification across thousands of independent nodes worldwide. With a strictly governed hard cap of 21 million coins and quadrennial halving cycles, Bitcoin serves as the institutional benchmark digital reserve asset.

ETH.name: Ethereum Protocol
ETH.description: Ethereum is a decentralized, open-source blockchain with smart contract functionality. Ether is the native cryptocurrency of the platform, powering decentralized finance (DeFi), non-fungible tokens (NFTs), institutional asset tokenization, and Layer-2 rollup ecosystems (Arbitrum, Base, Optimism).

SOL.name: Solana Network
SOL.description: Solana is a high-performance blockchain platform designed for widespread, mainstream adoption. Benefiting from its novel Proof-of-History (PoH) consensus mechanism coupled with Proof-of-Stake, Solana processes thousands of transactions per second with sub-second finality and sub-penny gas fees.

SPY.name: SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust
SPY.description: The SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) is the oldest, most liquid, and widely held exchange-traded fund in the world. Managed by State Street Global Advisors, SPY corresponds generally to the price and yield performance of the S&P 500 Index, representing 500 leading US public companies across approximately 80% of available market capitalization.

QQQ.name: Invesco QQQ Trust
QQQ.description: Invesco QQQ Trust is an exchange-traded fund that tracks the Nasdaq-100 Index. The fund features 100 of the largest and most innovative non-financial companies listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market based on market capitalization, heavily weighted toward transformative technology, communication, and consumer leaders.
